text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],"utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":21}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":28}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":28,"end":52}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":12}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":12,"end":38}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":33}]}],"learningValue":"掌握轉述他人話語時的動詞人稱（dijo）與代名詞接語規則（dime），學習轉換話題的常用片語（Por cierto），以及運用無人稱／被動 se（se entiende）表達事物無法被理解或辨識。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"分析轉述動詞「dijo」為第三人稱單數（指稱 Leo）而非當前聽者，並辨析命令式接續單一代名詞「dime」時依規則不需標記重音符號。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"學習日常生活對話中用於切換話題的常用片語「Por cierto」（對了、順便問一下）。"},{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c4"],"description":"理解「se entiende」中被動／無人稱 se 的結構，掌握其在否定句中表示「看不清、無法被理解」的用法。"}]}]}
